camel_example: aliyun eiam SetIdentityProviderUdPullConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --PullProtectedRule.UserDeletedThreshold 30 --IdentityProviderId idp_my664lwkhpicbyzirog3xxxxx --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --PullProtectedRule.GroupDeletedThreshold 10 --LdapUdPullConfig.UserObjectClassCustomFilter 'cn=test_mail=test@test.com' --LdapUdPullConfig.GroupObjectClassCustomFilter 'cn=test_group=test@test.com' --PullProtectedRule.OrganizationalUnitDeletedThreshold 10 --LdapUdPullConfig.GroupMemberAttributeName member --PeriodicSyncConfig.PeriodicSyncCron 0_45_1_0_0_0 --LdapUdPullConfig.UserObjectClass 'userPrincipalName,_mail' --UdSyncScopeConfig.TargetScope ou_asdaq1addsxzdq1XXX --PeriodicSyncStatus disabled --PeriodicSyncConfig.PeriodicSyncTimes.1 3 --UdSyncScopeConfig.SourceScopes.1 ou_asdaq1addsxzdq1XXX --LdapUdPullConfig.OrganizationUnitObjectClass 'organizationUnit,top' --LdapUdPullConfig.GroupObjectClass group --PeriodicSyncConfig.PeriodicSyncType cron --GroupSyncStatus disabled --IncrementalCallbackStatus disabled --method POST --force
description_en: Modifies the inbound synchronization configuration of an Identity Provider (IdP)
description_zh: 修改IdP同步入方向配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun eiam set-identity-provider-ud-pull-configuration --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --identity-provider-id idp_my664lwkhpicbyzirog3xxxxx --incremental-callback-status disabled --group-sync-status disabled --ud-sync-scope-config '{"SourceScopes":["ou_asdaq1addsxzdq1XXX"],"TargetScope":"ou_asdaq1addsxzdq1XXX"}' --pull-protected-rule UserDeletedThreshold=30 OrganizationalUnitDeletedThreshold=10 GroupDeletedThreshold=10 --ldap-ud-pull-config GroupObjectClass=group UserObjectClassCustomFilter=cn=test_mail=test@test.com GroupObjectClassCustomFilter=cn=test_group=test@test.com OrganizationUnitObjectClass=organizationUnit,top UserObjectClass=userPrincipalName,_mail GroupMemberAttributeName=member --periodic-sync-status disabled --periodic-sync-config '{"PeriodicSyncCron":"0_45_1_0_0_0","PeriodicSyncTimes":[3],"PeriodicSyncType":"cron"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetIdentityProviderUdPullConfiguration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to process incremental callback data from the IdP. Valid values:

- disabled: Disabled.

- enabled: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
增量回调状态，是否处理来自IdP的增量回调数据。取值范围：

- 禁用：disabled

- 启用：enabled
parameters.name: incremental_callback_status

parameters.help_en:
The group synchronization status. Valid values:
- disabled: Disabled.

- enabled: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
组同步状态。取值范围：
- 禁用：disabled

- 启用：enabled
parameters.name: group_sync_status

fields.help_en: The list of source nodes for synchronization
fields.name: source_scopes

fields.help_en: The threshold for the number of deleted accounts. If the number of deleted users exceeds this value, the synchronization task is terminated
fields.help_zh: 删除账户数量阈值，删除用户数量超过该值，同步任务终止
fields.name: user_deleted_threshold

fields.help_en: The threshold for the number of deleted organizational units. If the number of deleted organizational units exceeds this value, the synchronization task is terminated
fields.help_zh: 删除组织数量阈值，删除组织数量超过该值，同步任务终止
fields.name: organizational_unit_deleted_threshold

fields.help_en: The threshold for the number of deleted groups. If the number of deleted groups exceeds this value, the synchronization task is terminated
fields.help_zh: 删除组数量阈值，删除组数量超过该值，同步任务终止
fields.name: group_deleted_threshold

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to periodically verify data differences between IDaaS and the identity provider. Valid values:

- disabled: Disabled.

- enabled: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
定时校验状态，是否定时校验IDaaS与身份提供方的数据差异。取值范围：

- 禁用：disabled

- 启用：enabled
parameters.name: periodic_sync_status

fields.help_en: The cron expression. This parameter is required when periodicSyncType is set to cron
fields.name: periodic_sync_cron

fields.help_en: The execution time points. This parameter is required when periodicSyncType is set to time. For example, [3, 5] indicates that the task runs once between 3:00 and 4:00 and once between 5:00 and 6:00
fields.help_zh: 执行时间点，当periodicSyncType=time，必填，如[3，5]，即3点到4点执行一次，5点到6点执行一次
fields.name: periodic_sync_times
